reviews.sourceExplanation:
Resultant—The resultant of a force system is a force or a couple that will have the same effect on the body in both translation and rotation if all the forces are removed and replaced by the resultant.
Rₓ: The x-component of the resultant equals the sum of forces in the x-direction.
Rᵧ: The y-component equals the sum of forces in the y-direction.
R_z: The z-component equals the sum of forces in the z-direction.
Rₓ=ΣFₓ=Fₓ₁+Fₓ₂+Fₓ₃+… .
Rᵧ=ΣFᵧ=Fᵧ₁+Fᵧ₂+Fᵧ₃+… .
R_z=ΣF_z=F_z₁+F_z₂+F_z₃+… .
R=√(Rₓ²+Rᵧ²), sinceΣH=0=ΣFₓ.
